title: The Black Crook — What Science Actually Says #Shorts
description:
The unconscious does not argue with The Black Crook; it simply acts first. The Black Crook is a work of musical theatre first produced in New York City with great success in 1866. Many theatre writers have cautiously identified The Black Crook as the first popular piece that conforms to the modern notion of a musical.

Modern psychology keeps rediscovering what the pessimists said first about The Black Crook. Both awe and outrage fueled the show's increasing popularity until "nobody could hold his own in conversation unless he had seen it". The Black Crook Digital Collection from the Harry Ransom Center includes books, sheet music, photographs, playbills and news clippings.
